next_boundary.heading: CHAP XLV A sick Doctor, what was his Disease? If curable?

records.normalized_draft: Ascendant, its lord and figure lord signify sick person
records.qualifier_draft: No fixed patient chart without an actual question

records.normalized_draft: Examine sixth sign and its lord, occupying planets, and the Moon's sign to identify alleged diseased part
Seventh signifies physician; tenth medicine; misfortune to their lords implies failure or improper physic
Fourth signifies illness end; fixed prolongation; common variation; movable faster change
records.qualifier_draft: Sign quality modifies ending, not automatically prognosis of death

records.normalized_draft: Physician first attending in Saturn's hour is said to face long illness or long cure and severe frustration
First treatment in Mars's hour is said to yield disaffected patient and poor reception/payment
First visit in Jupiter/Venus hour predicts patient goodwill and remuneration even without cure
When urine from patient is brought, ascendant signifies the sick regardless of patient's consent
Without urine or patient consent, ascendant signifies querent and patient located by relational house; a servant example uses sixth from sixth
Moon is a general significatrix in every disease
records.qualifier_draft: Do not confuse with individual house ruler

records.normalized_draft: Sun and Moon both under Earth at question or illness onset imply great danger of death
Both lights obscured or below Earth at first lying-down, worse if afflicted, are said to remove hope of recovery
records.qualifier_draft: Source's strong prognosis, not clinical evidence

records.normalized_draft: Square/opposition of benefics not automatically destroys; favourable aspect of malefics does not help unless reception
records.qualifier_draft: Exact source opposition and reception conditions

records.normalized_draft: Luminaries or figure/ascendant lords free of affliction and without connection to eighth imply recovery; two afflicted still said to go well, otherwise die
records.qualifier_draft: Source apparent ambiguity; must inspect literal and referents

records.normalized_draft: Ascendant lord in fall, unfortunate or combust, or figure lord afflicted, raises doubt and predicted death
Weak sick significator strongly afflicted by eighth ruler produces fear of death
records.qualifier_draft: Both weakness and eighth ruler strength matter

records.normalized_draft: Ascendant lord in eighth received by eighth lord via essential dignity, even unreciprocated, permits unexpected recovery
Ascendant lord and Moon applying by ill aspect to a planet under Earth feared; above-Earth application reverses verdict; houses specified
Eighth lord on tenth cusp and ascendant lord under Earth produces source expression 'great fear of recovery'
records.qualifier_draft: Do not silently emend odd polarity

records.normalized_draft: Fast waxing Moon applying sextile/trine to ascendant ruler hastens cure, with reception and above-Earth location further favourable
records.qualifier_draft: Speed, waxing, aspect, reception and position separate

records.normalized_draft: Sixth ruler in ascendant or ascendant ruler sixth prolongs disease; sixth lord square/opposition to asc lord adds affliction
Jupiter/Venus strongest in figure support hopeful judgment; stronger malefics give opposite
Fourth ruler conjunct applying to eighth ruler prolongs illness; death if fourth ruler infortune; contrary if benefic
Retrograde disease significator predicts duration, consumption, relapse and backsliding
Stationary disease significator predicts nausea/vomiting and changes; if combust Sun, patient usually dies
Disease significator in fall or detriment means sickness and anger/displeasure
Afflicted ascendant and Moon with qualified relationship between their lords/dispositors locates disease in body not spirits
records.qualifier_draft: Exact reciprocal clauses require close reading

records.normalized_draft: Unafflicted ascendant/Moon with afflicted lords puts grief in spirits; both afflicted troubles body and mind; differential ascendant/Moon affliction distinguishes animals/body
Sixth lord in ascendant, ninth, eleventh or tenth indicates manifest disease; seventh, fourth, twelfth, eighth occult
records.qualifier_draft: Exact house sets rather than generic angular labels

records.normalized_draft: Movable sign makes illness variable; fixed sign long/permanent; common sign recurrence or new disorder
At beginning consider Moon's affliction and ascendant lord condition together
If patient's nativity available, illness Moon upon natal infortune radix or square/opposition indicates difficult cure
Illness-start Moon in natal sixth/fourth/seventh/eighth/twelfth with infortune at both times indicates death absent fortune beams
Onset ascendant opposite natal ascendant under named natal houses with return ascendant mismatch indicates little recovery
Second-house ruler afflicting ascendant ruler implies costly cure; if death, most money spent in vain
Sun in ascendant usually immediate improvement, in sixth change, eighth lord combust prevents dying at that time
Sun metaphorically light of heaven, claimed to destroy enemies of signs inhabited
records.qualifier_draft: General authorial rationale, not separate patient

records.normalized_draft: Jupiter good aspect to Sun excludes death even if ascendant ruler applies eighth ruler
Moon separating from combustion at initial illness predicts increase until lunar opposition to Sun
records.qualifier_draft: Timing sequence, not necessarily calendar days

records.normalized_draft: Ascendant ruler unfortunate in eighth said to enlarge disease and delay cure
Occidental significator chronic, oriental new illness; Moon's separation and application track decrease/increase
Saturn signifies cold causes; Mars or Sun heat/dryness; analogous attributions to other planets
records.qualifier_draft: Runs across PDF319–320; no modern physiology

records.normalized_draft: Moon waxing said more afflicted by Mars, waning by Saturn; Mars stronger harm when masculine sign, oriental and above Earth, Saturn contrary
records.qualifier_draft: Source closing aphorism; retain joint qualifiers
